doc.name: Lity Club
doc.description: Lity is an AI legal copilot for foreigners in Spain. A person describes their legal situation in plain language (English, Spanish or Russian); Lity's AI assistant asks clarifying questions, analyses the situation against a curated corpus of Spanish legislation with exact article citations, and assembles a structured case file (facts, documents, deadlines, action plan) the person can act on themselves or hand to a lawyer. Lity is a technology platform, NOT a law firm. Its analysis is informational and does not constitute legal advice or create an attorney-client relationship.

provider.organization: UAB Redela and UAB IPLK (both Vilnius, Lithuania)
